scope: Workflow publicar_iskvw, checkout WORKSPACE/flujo and Hub source WORKSPACE
constraint: Plan only; no repository files or running processes changed. Existing dirty worktree state must be preserved.

problem_statement.observed: HEAD contains tools/validar_curaduria.py and iskvw data/editor, but does not contain tools/gen_archivo_iskvw.py or cultura/mak_plataforma/contrato_archivo.py; workflow invokes the generator at line 59.
problem_statement.impact: Publication cannot be reproduced from its own checkout; local Hub defaults to a different tree and generated archivo.json is outside the workflow checkout.

options.action: Make WORKSPACE/flujo self-contained: add the generator and its contract dependency under tracked paths, then update imports/packaging only as needed.
options.tradeoff: Requires a scoped repository change and reconciliation with existing dirty worktree/branch history.
gates: generator dry-run/output test in isolated staging

options.action: Change workflow checkout/source to the repository that canonically owns generator, contract and iskvw, while making the Hub point to the same revision.
options.tradeoff: Requires explicit repository ownership and CI credentials; cross-tree assumptions disappear only if both runtime and workflow use the same revision.
gates: source revision is recorded in artifact
Hub PORTFOLIO_ROOT and workflow root agree

options.action: Extract generator/contract into a versioned shared package or submodule consumed by both roots.
options.tradeoff: Highest setup cost but reduces future copy drift; package version must be pinned.

execution_sequence.name: freeze evidence
actions: Preserve current dirty worktree; do not reset or clean.
Record current HEAD, branch, source_root and hashes.

execution_sequence.name: repair dependency closure
actions: Ensure generator, contract and all source inputs exist in the publishing checkout.

execution_sequence.name: build isolated staging
actions: Run validator, skin smoke and artifact exposure scan.

execution_sequence.name: publish gate
actions: Compare manifest, source hash, generator version and generated timestamp.
Upload only when all guards pass.

execution_sequence.name: runtime reconciliation
actions: Set Hub root to the same canonical tree/revision.
Expose freshness and source_root in contract.

acceptance_matrix.proof: all required paths exist in HEAD and import/compile succeeds
same declared inputs produce recorded output hash
artifact manifest excludes editor, mesa_montaje.js, curaduria.json, micelio.json; tablero only if approved public config
workflow_dispatch, human consent policy, smoke/coherence tests and exposure scanner all pass
Hub and workflow report identical canonical root/revision

rollback.safe: Do not modify current repositories during investigation; if a repair is later applied, revert only the scoped commit after preserving generated manifests.
rollback.prohibited: Do not delete/archive current dirty files or stop unrelated services.
